blocks.text: Pelajaran ini tentang membandingkan: «kamar ini lebih murah dari kamar kita», «toko ini pengirimannya paling cepat», «kopi ini sekuat punyamu», «tasnya terlalu besar», «hubungan kita baik sekali». Hampir semuanya cuma tambahan kecil pada kata sifat.

examples.en: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.
examples.translation: Kamar hotel ini lebih murah dari kamar kita.

examples.en: This shop has the shortest delivery time.
This instant coffee is as strong as yours.
This cabin bag is too big.
We have such a good relationship.

blocks.text: Untuk «lebih murah», «lebih tenang», «lebih panjang», kata sifat diberi -er, dan «dari / daripada» adalah than: cheaper than ours. «Lebih» sudah ada di dalam -er, jadi jangan tambah more: bukan more cheaper.

examples.en: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.
examples.translation: Kamar hotel ini lebih murah dari kamar kita.

examples.en: The shared bathroom is cleaner than before.
examples.translation: Kamar mandi bersama lebih bersih dari sebelumnya.

examples.en: The train journey is shorter than ours.
examples.translation: Perjalanan kereta lebih singkat dari perjalanan kita.

examples.en: The airport bus is slower than a taxi.
examples.translation: Bus bandara lebih lambat daripada taksi.

examples.en: These leather shoes are softer than that pair.
examples.translation: Sepatu kulit ini lebih lembut dari pasangan yang itu.

fixes.wrong: This hotel room is more cheaper than ours.
fixes.right: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.

fixes.wrong: This hotel room is cheap than ours.
fixes.right: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.

fixes.wrong: The shared bathroom is cleaner that before.
fixes.right: The shared bathroom is cleaner than before.

blocks.text: Kalau memilih satu dari semuanya — «paling murah», «paling dekat» — kata sifat diberi -est dan di depannya wajib the: the shortest delivery time, the nearest shop. «Paling» sudah ada di -est: bukan most cheapest.

examples.en: This shop has the shortest delivery time.
This clinic has the longest waiting time.
examples.translation: Di klinik ini antrenya paling lama.

examples.en: This local shop is the nearest.
examples.translation: Warung dekat rumah ini yang paling dekat.

examples.en: The plain yoghurt is the cheapest option.
We booked the earliest home visit.
examples.translation: Kami pesan kunjungan rumah paling awal.

fixes.wrong: This shop has shortest delivery time.
fixes.right: This shop has the shortest delivery time.

fixes.wrong: This shop has the most shortest delivery time.
fixes.right: This shop has the shortest delivery time.

drill.question: Kamu melihat tiga toko. Yang ini paling besar. Kamu bilang apa?
drill.optionA: This chain store is the larger.
drill.optionB: This chain store is the largest.

blocks.text: Kalau tidak ada bedanya — «sekuat punyamu» — kata sifat diletakkan di antara dua as: as strong as yours. Bahasa Indonesia cukup awalan «se-», bahasa Inggris perlu as di depan dan di belakang, bukan with atau same.

examples.en: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.
This green tea is as cheap as that one.
examples.translation: Teh hijau ini semurah yang itu.

examples.en: These reading glasses are as light as mine.
This electric kettle is as fast as ours.
examples.translation: Teko listrik ini secepat punya kita.

fixes.wrong: This instant coffee is as strong with yours.
fixes.right: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.

fixes.wrong: This instant coffee is as strong than yours.
fixes.right: This instant coffee is as strong as yours.

fixes.wrong: This ground coffee is fresh as yours.
fixes.right: This ground coffee is as fresh as yours.

blocks.text: too — «terlalu», mengganggu: This cabin bag is too big. enough — «cukup», pas: This checked bag is light enough. Bahasa Indonesia bilang «cukup ringan», bahasa Inggris menaruh enough di belakang: light enough.

examples.en: This cabin bag is too big.
This checked bag is light enough.
The monthly rent is too high.
The rental deposit is low enough.
This driveway is too narrow.
examples.translation: Jalan masuk mobil ini terlalu sempit.

fixes.wrong: This checked bag is enough light.
fixes.right: This checked bag is light enough.

fixes.wrong: This cabin bag is big too.
fixes.right: This cabin bag is too big.

blocks.text: Kalau tidak ada benda sesudahnya — so: My close friend is so kind («baik sekali»). Kalau sesudah kata sifat ada benda — such: such a helpful person, such hard work. Urutannya such a, bukan a such.

formula.text: dengan benda: such a + kata sifat + benda

examples.en: My close friend is so kind.
Our mutual friend is such a helpful person.
examples.translation: Teman kita bersama orangnya suka menolong sekali.

examples.en: This is such hard work.
The live music is so loud.
You have such a good memory.

fixes.wrong: Our mutual friend is so a helpful person.
fixes.right: Our mutual friend is such a helpful person.

fixes.wrong: My close friend is such kind.
fixes.right: My close friend is so kind.

fixes.wrong: Our mutual friend is a such helpful person.
fixes.right: Our mutual friend is such a helpful person.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.right: This hotel room is cheaper than ours.

fixes.right: This shop has the shortest delivery time.

blocks.text: Dua hal — -er than. Satu dari semua — the -est. Sama — as … as. Mengganggu — too di depan, pas — enough di belakang. Tanpa benda — so, dengan benda — such a.
-er than — membandingkan dua hal. the -est — memilih satu dari semua. as … as — «sama». too / enough — «terlalu» dan «cukup». so / such — so tanpa benda, such dengan benda.

examples.en: The sale price is lower than before.
examples.translation: Harga diskonnya lebih rendah dari sebelumnya.

examples.en: This dining table is the widest.
This is such a big improvement.
